name: gmail-followup
description: Use the Gmail Follow-Up Tool from Claude: see your sequences and campaigns, start follow-ups on sent emails, send campaigns and stop follow-ups. Everything previews first and waits for your yes.

tools.name: status

tools.name: list_sent_threads

tools.name: stop_campaign
